posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md: Have the 2015 ISDH Proceedings been published? I'd like to get a copy.

posts.author: lobaz
posts.content_md:
Hi, John,

as far as I know, they were not published officially yet. It would be the best to contact Alkis Lembessis for info, either on the facebook/Holography forum, or directly at [http://www.hih.org.gr/en/home/contacts.html](http://www.hih.org.gr/en/home/contacts.html).

Petr

posts.author: Ed Wesly
posts.content_md: They were published, I saw a copy at ISDH 2018, but they wanted 60 Euros for them regardless of whether you were a participant or not, to cover the cost of the hologram on the cover, according to Hans. He also said that David Radcliffe had brought only 7 of them. Maybe Hans or Alkis or someone from ITMO, the sponsoring site, should weigh in here with the facts. [http://isdh2015.ifmo.ru/](http://isdh2015.ifmo.ru/)
